name: com.tencent.qcloud.tim.push.TIMPushService
description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM) initializes its offline-push service when the app starts and watches sign-in and sign-out to register or remove the device's push token. It also routes push-notification taps back to the app.
disableEffect: Tencent Cloud IM offline-message notifications and push-notification tap handling stop.
